message:
feat(api,embed): v2.1.0 - public JSON API and embeddable item widgets

API (static, generated at build, CORS-enabled via vercel.json):
  /api/index.json          - API index with version, categories, endpoints
  /api/values.json         - all 330 items, compact, sorted by value
  /api/item/<slug>.json    - one item with history and beequip rolls
  /api/history/<slug>.json - price history only
  /api/category/<slug>.json - items of one category

Embeddable widgets:
  /w/<slug>/               - self-contained card, no JS frameworks, <14 KB,
                             embeddable in any iframe, light/dark aware,
                             OG tags so it also works as a link preview
  /w/<slug>/?embed=1       - same without the footer link
  /w/                      - index of all widgets
- item modal links to the page, the widget and the JSON
- site footer links to the API index
- Discord /price now offers a 'Виджет' button next to the site link
author: BSS Index Developer
